source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the ABO blood group system (PDF 92-94).

blocks.text: Landsteiner ne 1901 mein ABO system daryaft kiya. Us ne red blood cells par do antigens paye, antigen-A aur antigen-B: kuch logon mein antigen-A, kuch mein antigen-B aur bohat se logon mein koi nahi. Baad mein us ke shagirdon ne dekha ke kuch logon mein dono hain. Groups ke naam A (antigen-A), B (antigen-B), AB (dono) aur O (koi nahi) rakhe gaye.

Har shakhs ke plasma mein us antigen ke khilaf antibodies hoti hain jo us mein nahi: group A mein anti-B aur group B mein anti-A antibodies. Ise Landsteiner ka antigen-antibody taalluq ka qaida kehte hain.

ABO system ko gene I ('I' iso-haem-agglutinogen ke liye) qaboo karta hai jo chromosome 9 par hai aur jis ke multiple alleles IA, IB aur i hain. IA aur IB aapas mein co-dominant aur i dono ke muqable mein recessive hai. IA antigen-A, IB antigen-B banata aur i koi antigen nahi banata.

blocks.alt: Chaar column wala table. Genotypes IAIA ya IAi, IBIB ya IBi, IAIB aur ii. Red blood cells par antigens: aik cell par gol antigen-A, doosre par chaukor antigen-B, teesre par dono, chauthe par koi antigen nahi. Plasma mein antibodies (Y shaklein): anti-B; anti-A; na anti-A na anti-B; anti-A aur anti-B. Phenotypes (blood groups): A, B, AB, O.

blocks.text: ABO system mein transfusion ka usool

Agar na milne wala khoon diya jaye to lene wale ki antibodies dene wale ke red cells ke antigens par hamla kar ke unhein guchha (agglutination) bana deti hain. Aisa tab hota hai jab group A ko group B diya jaye ya ulta, aur jab donor AB aur recipient A, B ya O ho.

items: Group O donor ke paas antigen-A ya antigen-B nahi, is liye A, B, AB ya O sab ko diya ja sakta hai: group O ABO system ke universal donors hain.
Group AB recipient ke paas anti-A ya anti-B antibodies nahi, is liye sab qisam le sakta hai: group AB ABO system ke universal recipients hain.

blocks.text: Kitab allele i ki zyada maujoodgi aise crosses se samjhati hai jo sab group O bachche dete hain: ii x ii sirf group O deta; IA i x IA i, IB i x IB i aur IA i x IB i har aik 25% group O (ii) deta hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Kuch log A aur B antigens jism ke mayi jaise thook, aansu aur peshab mein chhorte hain; un ke chromosome 19 par dominant secretor gene 'Se' hota hai. Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai ke anti-A aur anti-B antibodies antigens se mile baghair, janeeni zindagi se ban'ne lagti hain; aksar hawalon ke mutabiq yeh paidaish ke baad pehle maheenon mein zahir hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Group A mard aur group B biwi ke chaar bachche hain, har aik ka blood group alag. Yeh kaise mumkin hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono walidain heterozygous hain: IA i x IB i se IA IB (AB), IA i (A), IB i (B) aur i i (O), har aik 1/4 ehtimal se.

blocks.prompt: Group B aurat ka bachcha group O hai. Maa aur bachche ke genotypes kya hain, aur baap ke kaun se genotypes nahi ho sakte?
blocks.explanation: Bachcha i i; maa IB i. Baap ne i diya hoga, is liye woh IA IA, IB IB ya IA IB nahi ho sakta.

items: IA aur IB co-dominant, i recessive; gene I chromosome 9 par.
Plasma mein ghair maujood ABO antigens ke khilaf antibodies.
O universal donor, AB universal recipient (ABO).
